rows.text: copies 0xC-byte entries (qword `+0` and dword `+8`) from `rcx` up to `rdx` to `r8`, skipping the copy of an entry while the destination pointer is null but still advancing it, and returns the destination end

returns 0 when `rdx` is 0 and calls the import at `008C2608` (no return) when it is above 0x1555555555555555; with `n` = `rdx`*0xC it returns `00210EC0(n)` when `n` is below 0x1000; otherwise it allocates `00210EC0(n+0x27)` (calling `008C2608` when that sum overflows) and returns the result + 0x27 rounded down to 0x20 with the raw pointer stored at qword `-8`; a null allocation calls the import at `008C2DA8` (no return)
